content.inline: WhatsApp Cloud API: use v/ops/whatsapp/bots to find bindings and webhook paths; v/ops/whatsapp/send accepts {bot?, to, text, reply_to?}. Only admitted numeric WhatsApp IDs are supported. Incoming agent messages are the sender's text, or {text, attachments?, content?} when they carry media; the venue's From element before the turn names who sent it: the Covia principal it comes from, how it stands to the agent, and the sender's WhatsApp ID. A reply is delivered to that sender. Voice notes, photos, video, documents and stickers arrive as attachments with kind, mediaType, voice (true for a voice note), and a protected ref to the stored file; text is then the caption, empty for a bare voice note. A configured mediaOperation may add transcribed or extracted text to an attachment, and images also arrive as image blocks. Without a transcription in an attachment's text, do not claim to have listened to audio. v/ops/whatsapp/download accepts {bot?, media_id, destination?, fileName?} and saves the media of a raw WhatsApp message, whose image, audio, video, document or sticker object carries the media id, returning {ref, fileName, size, media_id, contentType?}; omit destination for the binding owner's private whatsapp drive, or name a directory you may write to. It needs whatsapp/download on the binding, which whatsapp/send does not grant. Text sends are subject to the customer-service window; sending templates or media, and OAuth onboarding, are outside this module. Do not retry an uncertain send. Operators configure secret references, the business account, phone-number ID and API version; see covia-whatsapp/README.md.

name: whatsapp
description: Send text, download received media and operate WhatsApp webhook bindings.
